description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseSkillsAPIConfig' for configuring and interacting with Skills API providers. It includes method signatures for validating environment, constructing API URLs, and transforming requests and responses related to skills management (create, list, get, delete). The file primarily establishes an interface for subclasses to implement provider-specific logic.

classes.name: BaseSkillsAPIConfig
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for skills API provider configurations, including methods for URL construction, request/response transformations, and environment validation.
